title: Data collection: sexual orientation, gender identity, and intersex status: disclosure.
summary: An act to amend Sections 44230.6 and 66027 of the Education Code, and to amend Section 8310.8 of, and to add Section 8310.8.5 to, the Government Code, relating to data collection.
